stateRules.value: A backyard ADU is allowed by right; Glendale's figures are reported as up to ~1,000 ft², 16 ft tall, 4 ft side/rear setbacks, regardless of the zone's coverage and floor-area limits
stateRules.source: California ADU law (Gov. Code 66314 et seq.); Glendale figures from a search summary of aduzoning.org - not from Glendale's ADU ordinance

stateRules.value: Up to 2 homes per lot, or a split into 2 lots, in single-family zones - NOT on a historic district or landmark property
stateRules.source: California SB 9 (Gov. Code 65852.21, 66411.7), from general knowledge - not checked against the statute here

adu.source: California ADU law (Gov. Code 66314 et seq.): side and rear setbacks capped at 4 ft; an ADU up to 800 ft² cannot be refused for lot coverage or floor area. Front setback assumed to be the zone's. Not checked against Glendale's ADU ordinance.
